import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# --- Data ---
vla_trained = [21,24,4,3,3,4,6,4,5,6,5,6,7,6,5,4,3,2,1,2,1,0,2,1,1,0,1,0,1,3,5,18]
pretrained  = [0,9,6,6,7,8,9,10,11,15,16,17,18,19,20,21,22,20,18,16,14,12,10,8,7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0]

C_PRETRAINED = '#0072B2'
C_VLA        = '#D55E00'
C_ARROW      = '#555555'
C_ENTRY      = '#FBDCDB'
C_MID        = '#EEEEEE'
C_LLM_BG     = '#EDF2FA'

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7.0, 3.6))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(1, 2, width_ratios=[0.6, 1.35], wspace=0.05)

# ============================================================
# Panel (a): Simplified VLA architecture
# ============================================================
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax.set_xlim(-1, 11)
ax.set_ylim(-0.5, 20)
ax.axis('off')

ax.text(-0.5, 19.5, '(a)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='top')

akw = dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_ARROW, lw=1.2, mutation_scale=12)
pcx = 4.0

def simple_box(cx, cy, w, h, label, fc, fs=8.5, ec='#999', bold=False):
    r = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (cx-w/2, cy-h/2), w, h, boxstyle='round,pad=0.12',
        facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(r)
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs,
            color='#333', zorder=4, fontweight=fw)

# Instruction bubble
ax.text(8.5, 18.0, '"Pick up the\n  red block"', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center',
        style='italic', color='#555',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFFDE7',
                  edgecolor='#CCCC88', linewidth=0.6))

# Pipeline boxes - generous vertical spacing
y_img  = 18.5
y_ve   = 16.5
y_proj = 14.8

simple_box(pcx, y_img,  2.8, 0.8, 'Image', '#F0F0F0')
simple_box(pcx, y_ve,   4.0, 0.9, 'Vision Encoder', '#DFF0D8', fs=8)
simple_box(pcx, y_proj, 2.8, 0.8, 'Projector', '#E8E8E8')

# Arrows between pipeline stages
ax.annotate('', xy=(pcx, y_ve+0.45), xytext=(pcx, y_img-0.4), arrowprops=akw)
ax.annotate('', xy=(pcx, y_proj+0.4), xytext=(pcx, y_ve-0.45), arrowprops=akw)

# LLM Backbone block
llm_top = 13.0
llm_bot = 3.5
llm_w   = 5.5

llm_rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (pcx - llm_w/2, llm_bot), llm_w, llm_top - llm_bot,
    boxstyle='round,pad=0.18', facecolor=C_LLM_BG,
    edgecolor='#7799BB', linewidth=1.0, zorder=1)
ax.add_patch(llm_rect)
ax.text(pcx, llm_top + 0.35, 'LLM Backbone', fontsize=8.5,
        ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold', color='#446688')

ax.annotate('', xy=(pcx, llm_top), xytext=(pcx, y_proj-0.4), arrowprops=akw)

# Arrow from instruction to LLM top-right
ax.annotate('', xy=(pcx + llm_w/2 - 0.2, llm_top + 0.1),
            xytext=(7.5, 17.0),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#CC8800', lw=1.0, mutation_scale=11,
                            connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.3'))

# Layer rows inside LLM
layer_data = [
    ('L1',  C_ENTRY, 'Entry'),
    ('L2',  C_ENTRY, 'Entry'),
    ('L3',  C_MID,   None),
    ('...',  None,    None),
    ('L31', C_MID,   None),
    ('L32', C_ENTRY, 'Exit'),
]

n_items = len(layer_data)
layer_w = llm_w - 1.0
layer_h = 0.75
usable = llm_top - llm_bot - 1.2
gap = (usable - n_items * layer_h) / (n_items - 1)

for i, (lbl, fc, tag) in enumerate(layer_data):
    y_top = llm_top - 0.7 - i * (layer_h + gap)
    y_center = y_top - layer_h / 2
    if lbl == '...':
        ax.text(pcx, y_center, '. . .', fontsize=11, ha='center', va='center',
                color='#999', zorder=3)
        continue
    ec = '#CC8888' if tag else '#CCCCCC'
    lw = 1.0 if tag else 0.5
    r = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (pcx - layer_w/2, y_top - layer_h), layer_w, layer_h,
        boxstyle='round,pad=0.06', facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec,
        linewidth=lw, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(r)
    ax.text(pcx - layer_w/2 + 0.35, y_center, lbl, fontsize=7,
            ha='left', va='center', color='#555', zorder=3)
    if tag:
        ax.text(pcx + layer_w/4 + 0.2, y_center, tag, fontsize=6.5,
                ha='center', va='center', color=C_VLA, fontweight='bold', zorder=3)

# Action Head
y_act = 2.0
simple_box(pcx, y_act, 3.2, 0.9, 'Action Head', '#FFF3E0')
ax.text(pcx, y_act - 0.55, '(7-DoF)', fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='top', color='#888')
ax.annotate('', xy=(pcx, y_act+0.45), xytext=(pcx, llm_bot), arrowprops=akw)

# ============================================================
# Panel (b): Bar chart - cleaner annotations
# ============================================================
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax_b.text(-0.02, 1.07, '(b)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='top',
          transform=ax_b.transAxes)
ax_b.set_title('Instruction Attention Redistribution', fontsize=11, pad=6)

x = np.arange(32)
bw = 0.36

ax_b.bar(x - bw/2, pretrained, bw, color=C_PRETRAINED, alpha=0.78,
         label='Pretrained (Llama-2)', zorder=2)
ax_b.bar(x + bw/2, vla_trained, bw, color=C_VLA, alpha=0.88,
         label='VLA-trained', zorder=2)

ax_b.axhline(0, color='#BBBBBB', linewidth=1.5, zorder=1)
ax_b.text(16, -1.5, 'Untrained (all 0)', fontsize=7, ha='center', color='#AAAAAA')

ax_b.set_xlabel('Layer')
ax_b.set_ylabel('Instruction-dominant\nheads (out of 32)')
ax_b.set_xlim(-0.8, 31.8)
ax_b.set_ylim(-2.5, 34)

tp = list(range(0, 32, 4)) + [31]
ax_b.set_xticks(tp)
ax_b.set_xticklabels([f'L{i+1}' for i in tp], fontsize=8)
ax_b.set_yticks([0, 8, 16, 24, 32])
ax_b.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.2, zorder=0)

# Annotations — spread out, no overlap
t1 = ax_b.annotate('Entry\nlayers', xy=(1, 25), xytext=(5.5, 31),
                    fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=C_VLA, ha='center',
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_VLA, lw=1.2), zorder=5)
t1.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

t3 = ax_b.annotate('Mid-depth\npeak', xy=(17, 22.5), xytext=(13, 31),
                    fontsize=7.5, color=C_PRETRAINED, ha='center',
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_PRETRAINED, lw=0.9), zorder=5)
t3.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.0, foreground='white')])

t2 = ax_b.annotate('Exit\nlayer', xy=(31, 19), xytext=(28.5, 9),
                    fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=C_VLA, ha='center',
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_VLA, lw=1.2), zorder=5)
t2.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

ax_b.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

# ============================================================
outpath = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_15/projects/vla-ssd/docs/paper/figures/fig_teaser.pdf'
plt.savefig(outpath, dpi=300)
plt.savefig(outpath.replace('.pdf', '.png'), dpi=300)
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {outpath}')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

# ─── Color palette ────────────────────────────────────────────
TEAL    = '#0072B2'
AMBER   = '#E69F00'
CORAL   = '#D55E00'
GREEN   = '#009E73'

TEAL_L  = '#E8F4FD'
AMBER_L = '#FFF8E1'
CORAL_L = '#FDE8E4'
GREEN_L = '#E8F8F0'

TXT     = '#333333'
TXT2    = '#777777'
TXT3    = '#AAAAAA'
LN      = '#888888'

# ─── Figure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.5), facecolor='white')
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.04, 0.26, 0.88])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.30, 0.04, 0.38, 0.88])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.72, 0.04, 0.27, 0.88])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b, ax_c]:
    ax.axis('off')

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
def rbox(ax, cx, cy, w, h, label='', fc='white', ec='#CCC',
         fontsize=9, fontweight='normal', tc=TXT,
         lw=0.7, ls='-', pad=0.12, zorder=3, fontstyle='normal'):
    b = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
        boxstyle=f'round,pad={pad}',
        facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw,
        linestyle=ls, zorder=zorder)
    ax.add_patch(b)
    if label:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=tc, fontweight=fontweight,
                fontstyle=fontstyle, zorder=zorder + 1)

def farrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=LN, lw=0.8, ms=10,
           style='->', conn=None):
    props = dict(arrowstyle=style, color=color, lw=lw, mutation_scale=ms)
    if conn:
        props['connectionstyle'] = conn
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1), arrowprops=props)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL (a): VLA sequence structure
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_a.set_xlim(-2, 11)
ax_a.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)

ax_a.text(-1.5, 10.2, '(a)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='top')
ax_a.text(0.0, 10.0, 'VLA sequence structure', fontsize=9, va='top', color=TXT2)

CX = 4.5
BW = 7.0
BH = 1.3

# Image tokens
y_img = 8.2
rbox(ax_a, CX, y_img, BW, BH, fc=TEAL_L, ec=TEAL, ls='--', lw=0.6)
ax_a.text(CX - 1.5, y_img + 0.1, 'Image tokens', fontsize=9,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT, zorder=4)
for k in range(4):
    px = CX + 0.6 + k * 0.85
    ax_a.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (px - 0.25, y_img - 0.25), 0.5, 0.5,
        boxstyle='round,pad=0.04', facecolor=TEAL, alpha=0.22,
        edgecolor=TEAL, linewidth=0.3, zorder=4))

# Instruction tokens
y_ins = 5.6
rbox(ax_a, CX, y_ins, BW, BH, fc=AMBER_L, ec=AMBER, ls='--', lw=0.6)
ax_a.text(CX, y_ins + 0.28, 'Instruction tokens', fontsize=9,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT, zorder=4)
ax_a.text(CX, y_ins - 0.28, 'pick up the red block', fontsize=7.5,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT2, fontstyle='italic', zorder=4)

# Readout (R) + Action head
y_bot = 3.0
rbox(ax_a, CX - 1.8, y_bot, 2.2, 1.0, 'R', GREEN, GREEN,
     fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', tc='white', lw=0.5)
rbox(ax_a, CX + 1.8, y_bot, 2.2, 1.0, 'Act', CORAL, CORAL,
     fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', tc='white', lw=0.5)

# Vertical arrows
farrow(ax_a, CX, y_img - BH/2, CX, y_ins + BH/2)
farrow(ax_a, CX - 1.0, y_ins - BH/2, CX - 1.8, y_bot + 0.5)
farrow(ax_a, CX + 1.0, y_ins - BH/2, CX + 1.8, y_bot + 0.5)

# Red X between image and instruction
mid_y = (y_img + y_ins) / 2
xx = CX + 3.8
d = 0.25
ax_a.plot([xx - d, xx + d], [mid_y - d, mid_y + d],
          color='#CC0000', lw=2, zorder=5)
ax_a.plot([xx - d, xx + d], [mid_y + d, mid_y - d],
          color='#CC0000', lw=2, zorder=5)
ax_a.text(xx, mid_y + 0.55, 'cannot attend\nto instruction', fontsize=6,
          ha='center', va='bottom', color='#CC0000')

# Arc arrow: image → readout (attends to all context)
farrow(ax_a, CX - BW/2 - 0.1, y_img - 0.2,
       CX - 1.8 - 1.1, y_bot,
       color=TEAL, lw=1.0, conn='arc3,rad=0.4')
ax_a.text(-1.5, (y_img + y_bot) / 2, 'attends to\nall context',
          fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center', color=TEAL,
          fontstyle='italic')

# Position labels
ax_a.text(CX - 1.5, y_img - BH/2 - 0.15, 'image_mean', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='center', va='top', color=TXT3, fontstyle='italic')
ax_a.text(CX - 1.8, y_bot - 0.6, 'readout', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='center', va='top', color=TXT3, fontstyle='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL (b): Three analysis methods
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_b.set_xlim(-0.5, 14)
ax_b.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)

ax_b.text(-0.3, 10.2, '(b)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='top')
ax_b.text(1.2, 10.0, 'Three analysis methods', fontsize=9, va='top', color=TXT2)

# ── Method 1: Layer-wise action probes ────────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 9.0, 'Layer-wise action probes', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

m1y = 8.0
for i, lbl in enumerate(['L1', 'L2', 'L3']):
    rbox(ax_b, 0.7 + i * 1.1, m1y, 0.8, 0.6, lbl, TEAL_L, TEAL, fontsize=7.5)

farrow(ax_b, 3.2, m1y, 4.0, m1y)
rbox(ax_b, 4.8, m1y, 1.5, 0.6, 'Probe', '#F5F5F5', LN, fontsize=8)
farrow(ax_b, 5.55, m1y, 6.3, m1y)
rbox(ax_b, 7.5, m1y, 2.2, 0.6, '7-DoF action', CORAL_L, CORAL, fontsize=7.5)

# R² badge
rbox(ax_b, 9.3, m1y + 0.55, 0.65, 0.55, 'R²', '#FFEEEE', CORAL,
     fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', tc=CORAL, pad=0.12)

# ── Method 2: Counterfactual perturbation ─────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 6.2, 'Counterfactual perturbation', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

m2y = 5.3
capsules = [
    ('✓ correct instr.', GREEN_L, GREEN, 2.4),
    ('∅ empty',          '#F0F0F0', '#999999', 1.4),
    ('✗ wrong',          '#FFEEEE', '#CC0000', 1.4),
    ('◇ shuffle',        AMBER_L,   AMBER,    1.6),
    ('~ paraph.',        '#F5E6F5', '#AA44AA', 1.5),
]
x_pos = 0.3
for label, fc, ec, w in capsules:
    cx = x_pos + w / 2
    rbox(ax_b, cx, m2y, w, 0.55, label, fc, ec,
         fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold', tc=ec, pad=0.08)
    x_pos += w + 0.25

farrow(ax_b, x_pos + 0.2, m2y, x_pos + 1.0, m2y)
ax_b.text(x_pos + 1.2, m2y, 'Δaction', fontsize=7.5,
          ha='left', va='center', color=TXT)

# ── Method 3: L1 attention profiling ──────────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 3.3, 'L1 attention profiling', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

hm_x0, hm_y0 = 0.5, 0.5
cell = 0.55

# Attention matrix (bottom row = readout, top row = img1)
attn = np.array([
    [0.1, 0.1, 0.7, 0.1],   # r=0 (bottom): readout
    [0.2, 0.2, 0.6, 0.0],   # r=1: instruction
    [0.3, 0.7, 0.0, 0.0],   # r=2: img2
    [0.8, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0],   # r=3 (top): img1
])
row_labels = ['ro', 'inst', 'img', 'img']

for r in range(4):
    ax_b.text(hm_x0 - 0.15, hm_y0 + r * cell + cell / 2,
              row_labels[r], fontsize=5.5, ha='right', va='center', color=TXT2)
    for c in range(4):
        v = attn[r, c]
        fc = '#F5F5F5' if v < 0.01 else plt.cm.Blues(v * 0.7 + 0.15)
        rect = plt.Rectangle(
            (hm_x0 + c * cell, hm_y0 + r * cell), cell, cell,
            facecolor=fc, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
        ax_b.add_patch(rect)

# Highlight readout→instruction cell
rect_h = plt.Rectangle(
    (hm_x0 + 2 * cell, hm_y0), cell, cell,
    facecolor='none', edgecolor=TEAL, linewidth=1.5, zorder=5)
ax_b.add_patch(rect_h)

# Arrow from heatmap
hm_right = hm_x0 + 4 * cell + 0.3
hm_mid_y = hm_y0 + 2 * cell
farrow(ax_b, hm_right, hm_mid_y, hm_right + 1.2, hm_mid_y)

tx = hm_right + 1.5
ax_b.text(tx, hm_mid_y + 0.4, 'readout → instruction', fontsize=7,
          ha='left', va='center', color=TEAL, fontweight='bold')
ax_b.text(tx, hm_mid_y - 0.4, 'readout → image', fontsize=7,
          ha='left', va='center', color=AMBER, fontweight='bold')

# Bracket for "attention ratio"
br_x = tx + 4.5
ax_b.plot([br_x, br_x], [hm_mid_y - 0.6, hm_mid_y + 0.6],
          color=TXT2, lw=0.5, zorder=3)
ax_b.plot([br_x - 0.15, br_x], [hm_mid_y - 0.6, hm_mid_y - 0.6],
          color=TXT2, lw=0.5, zorder=3)
ax_b.plot([br_x - 0.15, br_x], [hm_mid_y + 0.6, hm_mid_y + 0.6],

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

# ─── Color palette ────────────────────────────────────────────
TEAL    = '#0072B2'
AMBER   = '#E69F00'
CORAL   = '#D55E00'
GREEN   = '#009E73'

TEAL_L  = '#E8F4FD'
AMBER_L = '#FFF8E1'
CORAL_L = '#FDE8E4'
GREEN_L = '#E8F8F0'

TXT     = '#333333'
TXT2    = '#777777'
TXT3    = '#AAAAAA'
LN      = '#888888'

# ─── Figure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.5), facecolor='white')
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.04, 0.26, 0.88])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.30, 0.04, 0.38, 0.88])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.72, 0.04, 0.27, 0.88])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b, ax_c]:
    ax.axis('off')

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
def rbox(ax, cx, cy, w, h, label='', fc='white', ec='#CCC',
         fontsize=9, fontweight='normal', tc=TXT,
         lw=0.7, ls='-', pad=0.12, zorder=3, fontstyle='normal'):
    b = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
        boxstyle=f'round,pad={pad}',
        facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw,
        linestyle=ls, zorder=zorder)
    ax.add_patch(b)
    if label:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=tc, fontweight=fontweight,
                fontstyle=fontstyle, zorder=zorder + 1)

def farrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=LN, lw=0.8, ms=10,
           style='->', conn=None):
    props = dict(arrowstyle=style, color=color, lw=lw, mutation_scale=ms)
    if conn:
        props['connectionstyle'] = conn
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1), arrowprops=props)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL (a): VLA sequence structure
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_a.set_xlim(-2, 11)
ax_a.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)

ax_a.text(-1.5, 10.2, '(a)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='top')
ax_a.text(0.0, 10.0, 'VLA sequence structure', fontsize=9, va='top', color=TXT2)

CX = 4.5
BW = 7.0
BH = 1.3

# Image tokens
y_img = 8.2
rbox(ax_a, CX, y_img, BW, BH, fc=TEAL_L, ec=TEAL, ls='--', lw=0.6)
ax_a.text(CX - 1.5, y_img + 0.1, 'Image tokens', fontsize=9,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT, zorder=4)
for k in range(4):
    px = CX + 0.6 + k * 0.85
    ax_a.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (px - 0.25, y_img - 0.25), 0.5, 0.5,
        boxstyle='round,pad=0.04', facecolor=TEAL, alpha=0.22,
        edgecolor=TEAL, linewidth=0.3, zorder=4))

# Instruction tokens
y_ins = 5.6
rbox(ax_a, CX, y_ins, BW, BH, fc=AMBER_L, ec=AMBER, ls='--', lw=0.6)
ax_a.text(CX, y_ins + 0.28, 'Instruction tokens', fontsize=9,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT, zorder=4)
ax_a.text(CX, y_ins - 0.28, 'pick up the red block', fontsize=7.5,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT2, fontstyle='italic', zorder=4)

# Readout (R) + Action head
y_bot = 3.0
rbox(ax_a, CX - 1.8, y_bot, 2.2, 1.0, 'R', GREEN, GREEN,
     fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', tc='white', lw=0.5)
rbox(ax_a, CX + 1.8, y_bot, 2.2, 1.0, 'Act', CORAL, CORAL,
     fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', tc='white', lw=0.5)

# Vertical arrows
farrow(ax_a, CX, y_img - BH/2, CX, y_ins + BH/2)
farrow(ax_a, CX - 1.0, y_ins - BH/2, CX - 1.8, y_bot + 0.5)
farrow(ax_a, CX + 1.0, y_ins - BH/2, CX + 1.8, y_bot + 0.5)

# Red X between image and instruction
mid_y = (y_img + y_ins) / 2
xx = CX + 3.8
d = 0.25
ax_a.plot([xx - d, xx + d], [mid_y - d, mid_y + d],
          color='#CC0000', lw=2, zorder=5)
ax_a.plot([xx - d, xx + d], [mid_y + d, mid_y - d],
          color='#CC0000', lw=2, zorder=5)
ax_a.text(xx, mid_y + 0.55, 'cannot attend\nto instruction', fontsize=6,
          ha='center', va='bottom', color='#CC0000')

# Arc arrow: image → readout (attends to all context)
farrow(ax_a, CX - BW/2 - 0.1, y_img - 0.2,
       CX - 1.8 - 1.1, y_bot,
       color=TEAL, lw=1.0, conn='arc3,rad=0.4')
ax_a.text(-1.5, (y_img + y_bot) / 2, 'attends to\nall context',
          fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center', color=TEAL,
          fontstyle='italic')

# Position labels
ax_a.text(CX - 1.5, y_img - BH/2 - 0.15, 'image_mean', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='center', va='top', color=TXT3, fontstyle='italic')
ax_a.text(CX - 1.8, y_bot - 0.6, 'readout', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='center', va='top', color=TXT3, fontstyle='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL (b): Three analysis methods
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_b.set_xlim(-0.5, 14)
ax_b.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)

ax_b.text(-0.3, 10.2, '(b)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='top')
ax_b.text(1.2, 10.0, 'Three analysis methods', fontsize=9, va='top', color=TXT2)

# ── Method 1: Layer-wise action probes ────────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 9.0, 'Layer-wise action probes', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

m1y = 8.0
for i, lbl in enumerate(['L1', 'L2', 'L3']):
    rbox(ax_b, 0.7 + i * 1.1, m1y, 0.8, 0.6, lbl, TEAL_L, TEAL, fontsize=7.5)

farrow(ax_b, 3.2, m1y, 4.0, m1y)
rbox(ax_b, 4.8, m1y, 1.5, 0.6, 'Probe', '#F5F5F5', LN, fontsize=8)
farrow(ax_b, 5.55, m1y, 6.3, m1y)
rbox(ax_b, 7.5, m1y, 2.2, 0.6, '7-DoF action', CORAL_L, CORAL, fontsize=7.5)

# R² badge
rbox(ax_b, 9.3, m1y + 0.55, 0.65, 0.55, 'R²', '#FFEEEE', CORAL,
     fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', tc=CORAL, pad=0.12)

# ── Method 2: Counterfactual perturbation ─────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 6.2, 'Counterfactual perturbation', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

m2y = 5.3
capsules = [
    ('✓ correct instr.', GREEN_L, GREEN, 2.4),
    ('∅ empty',          '#F0F0F0', '#999999', 1.4),
    ('✗ wrong',          '#FFEEEE', '#CC0000', 1.4),
    ('◇ shuffle',        AMBER_L,   AMBER,    1.6),
    ('~ paraph.',        '#F5E6F5', '#AA44AA', 1.5),
]
x_pos = 0.3
for label, fc, ec, w in capsules:
    cx = x_pos + w / 2
    rbox(ax_b, cx, m2y, w, 0.55, label, fc, ec,
         fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold', tc=ec, pad=0.08)
    x_pos += w + 0.25

farrow(ax_b, x_pos + 0.2, m2y, x_pos + 1.0, m2y)
ax_b.text(x_pos + 1.2, m2y, 'Δaction', fontsize=7.5,
          ha='left', va='center', color=TXT)

# ── Method 3: L1 attention profiling ──────────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 3.3, 'L1 attention profiling', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

hm_x0, hm_y0 = 0.5, 0.5
cell = 0.55

# Attention matrix (bottom row = readout, top row = img1)
attn = np.array([
    [0.1, 0.1, 0.7, 0.1],   # r=0 (bottom): readout

    [0.3, 0.7, 0.0, 0.0],   # r=2: img2

row_labels = ['ro', 'inst', 'img', 'img']

for r in range(4):
    ax_b.text(hm_x0 - 0.15, hm_y0 + r * cell + cell / 2,
              row_labels[r], fontsize=5.5, ha='right', va='center', color=TXT2)
    for c in range(4):
        v = attn[r, c]
        fc = '#F5F5F5' if v < 0.01 else plt.cm.Blues(v * 0.7 + 0.15)
        rect = plt.Rectangle(
            (hm_x0 + c * cell, hm_y0 + r * cell), cell, cell,
            facecolor=fc, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
        ax_b.add_patch(rect)

# Highlight readout→instruction cell
rect_h = plt.Rectangle(
    (hm_x0 + 2 * cell, hm_y0), cell, cell,

ax_b.add_patch(rect_h)

# Arrow from heatmap
hm_right = hm_x0 + 4 * cell + 0.3
hm_mid_y = hm_y0 + 2 * cell
farrow(ax_b, hm_right, hm_mid_y, hm_right + 1.2, hm_mid_y)

tx = hm_right + 1.5
ax_b.text(tx, hm_mid_y + 0.4, 'readout → instruction', fontsize=7,
          ha='left', va='center', color=TEAL, fontweight='bold')
ax_b.text(tx, hm_mid_y - 0.4, 'readout → image', fontsize=7,
          ha='left', va='center', color=AMBER, fontweight='bold')

# Bracket for "attention ratio"
br_x = tx + 4.5
ax_b.plot([br_x, br_x], [hm_mid_y - 0.6, hm_mid_y + 0.6],
          color=TXT2, lw=0.5, zorder=3)
ax_b.plot([br_x - 0.15, br_x], [hm_mid_y - 0.6, hm_mid_y - 0.6],
          color=TXT2, lw=0.5, zorder=3)
ax_b.plot([br_x - 0.15, br_x], [hm_mid_y + 0.6, hm_mid_y + 0.6],
          color=TXT2, lw=0.5, zorder=3)
ax_b.text(br_x + 0.3, hm_mid_y, 'attention\nratio', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='left', va='center', color=TXT2)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_c.set_xlim(-0.5, 11)
ax_c.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

# ─── Color palette ────────────────────────────────────────────
TEAL    = '#0072B2'
AMBER   = '#E69F00'
CORAL   = '#D55E00'
GREEN   = '#009E73'

TEAL_L  = '#E8F4FD'
AMBER_L = '#FFF8E1'
CORAL_L = '#FDE8E4'
GREEN_L = '#E8F8F0'

TXT     = '#333333'
TXT2    = '#777777'
TXT3    = '#AAAAAA'
LN      = '#888888'

# ─── Figure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.5), facecolor='white')
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.04, 0.26, 0.88])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.30, 0.04, 0.38, 0.88])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.72, 0.04, 0.27, 0.88])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b, ax_c]:
    ax.axis('off')

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
def rbox(ax, cx, cy, w, h, label='', fc='white', ec='#CCC',
         fontsize=9, fontweight='normal', tc=TXT,
         lw=0.7, ls='-', pad=0.12, zorder=3, fontstyle='normal'):
    b = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
        boxstyle=f'round,pad={pad}',
        facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw,
        linestyle=ls, zorder=zorder)
    ax.add_patch(b)
    if label:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=tc, fontweight=fontweight,
                fontstyle=fontstyle, zorder=zorder + 1)

def farrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=LN, lw=0.8, ms=10,
           style='->', conn=None):
    props = dict(arrowstyle=style, color=color, lw=lw, mutation_scale=ms)
    if conn:
        props['connectionstyle'] = conn
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1), arrowprops=props)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL (a): VLA sequence structure
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_a.set_xlim(-2, 11)
ax_a.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)

ax_a.text(-1.5, 10.2, '(a)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='top')
ax_a.text(0.0, 10.0, 'VLA sequence structure', fontsize=9, va='top', color=TXT2)

CX = 4.5
BW = 7.0
BH = 1.3

# Image tokens
y_img = 8.2
rbox(ax_a, CX, y_img, BW, BH, fc=TEAL_L, ec=TEAL, ls='--', lw=0.6)
ax_a.text(CX - 1.5, y_img + 0.1, 'Image tokens', fontsize=9,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT, zorder=4)
for k in range(4):
    px = CX + 0.6 + k * 0.85
    ax_a.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (px - 0.25, y_img - 0.25), 0.5, 0.5,
        boxstyle='round,pad=0.04', facecolor=TEAL, alpha=0.22,
        edgecolor=TEAL, linewidth=0.3, zorder=4))

# Instruction tokens
y_ins = 5.6
rbox(ax_a, CX, y_ins, BW, BH, fc=AMBER_L, ec=AMBER, ls='--', lw=0.6)
ax_a.text(CX, y_ins + 0.28, 'Instruction tokens', fontsize=9,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT, zorder=4)
ax_a.text(CX, y_ins - 0.28, 'pick up the red block', fontsize=7.5,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT2, fontstyle='italic', zorder=4)

# Readout (R) + Action head
y_bot = 3.0
rbox(ax_a, CX - 1.8, y_bot, 2.2, 1.0, 'R', GREEN, GREEN,
     fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', tc='white', lw=0.5)
rbox(ax_a, CX + 1.8, y_bot, 2.2, 1.0, 'Act', CORAL, CORAL,
     fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', tc='white', lw=0.5)

# Vertical arrows
farrow(ax_a, CX, y_img - BH/2, CX, y_ins + BH/2)
farrow(ax_a, CX - 1.0, y_ins - BH/2, CX - 1.8, y_bot + 0.5)
farrow(ax_a, CX + 1.0, y_ins - BH/2, CX + 1.8, y_bot + 0.5)

# Red X between image and instruction
mid_y = (y_img + y_ins) / 2
xx = CX + 3.8
d = 0.25
ax_a.plot([xx - d, xx + d], [mid_y - d, mid_y + d],
          color='#CC0000', lw=2, zorder=5)
ax_a.plot([xx - d, xx + d], [mid_y + d, mid_y - d],
          color='#CC0000', lw=2, zorder=5)
ax_a.text(xx, mid_y + 0.55, 'cannot attend\nto instruction', fontsize=6,
          ha='center', va='bottom', color='#CC0000')

# Arc arrow: image → readout (attends to all context)
farrow(ax_a, CX - BW/2 - 0.1, y_img - 0.2,
       CX - 1.8 - 1.1, y_bot,
       color=TEAL, lw=1.0, conn='arc3,rad=0.4')
ax_a.text(-1.5, (y_img + y_bot) / 2, 'attends to\nall context',
          fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center', color=TEAL,
          fontstyle='italic')

# Position labels
ax_a.text(CX - 1.5, y_img - BH/2 - 0.15, 'image_mean', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='center', va='top', color=TXT3, fontstyle='italic')
ax_a.text(CX - 1.8, y_bot - 0.6, 'readout', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='center', va='top', color=TXT3, fontstyle='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL (b): Three analysis methods
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_b.set_xlim(-0.5, 14)
ax_b.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)

ax_b.text(-0.3, 10.2, '(b)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='top')
ax_b.text(1.2, 10.0, 'Three analysis methods', fontsize=9, va='top', color=TXT2)

# ── Method 1: Layer-wise action probes ────────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 9.0, 'Layer-wise action probes', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

m1y = 8.0
for i, lbl in enumerate(['L1', 'L2', 'L3']):
    rbox(ax_b, 0.7 + i * 1.1, m1y, 0.8, 0.6, lbl, TEAL_L, TEAL, fontsize=7.5)

farrow(ax_b, 3.2, m1y, 4.0, m1y)
rbox(ax_b, 4.8, m1y, 1.5, 0.6, 'Probe', '#F5F5F5', LN, fontsize=8)
farrow(ax_b, 5.55, m1y, 6.3, m1y)
rbox(ax_b, 7.5, m1y, 2.2, 0.6, '7-DoF action', CORAL_L, CORAL, fontsize=7.5)

# R² badge
rbox(ax_b, 9.3, m1y + 0.55, 0.65, 0.55, 'R²', '#FFEEEE', CORAL,
     fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', tc=CORAL, pad=0.12)

# ── Method 2: Counterfactual perturbation ─────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 6.2, 'Counterfactual perturbation', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

m2y = 5.3
capsules = [
    ('✓ correct instr.', GREEN_L, GREEN, 2.4),
    ('∅ empty',          '#F0F0F0', '#999999', 1.4),
    ('✗ wrong',          '#FFEEEE', '#CC0000', 1.4),
    ('◇ shuffle',        AMBER_L,   AMBER,    1.6),
    ('~ paraph.',        '#F5E6F5', '#AA44AA', 1.5),
]
x_pos = 0.3
for label, fc, ec, w in capsules:
    cx = x_pos + w / 2
    rbox(ax_b, cx, m2y, w, 0.55, label, fc, ec,
         fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold', tc=ec, pad=0.08)
    x_pos += w + 0.25

farrow(ax_b, x_pos + 0.2, m2y, x_pos + 1.0, m2y)
ax_b.text(x_pos + 1.2, m2y, 'Δaction', fontsize=7.5,
          ha='left', va='center', color=TXT)

# ── Method 3: L1 attention profiling ──────────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 3.3, 'L1 attention profiling', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

hm_x0, hm_y0 = 0.5, 0.5
cell = 0.55

# Attention matrix (bottom row = readout, top row = img1)
attn = np.array([
    [0.1, 0.1, 0.7, 0.1],   # r=0 (bottom): readout
    [0.2, 0.2, 0.6, 0.0],   # r=1: instruction
    [0.3, 0.7, 0.0, 0.0],   # r=2: img2
    [0.8, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0],   # r=3 (top): img1
])
row_labels = ['ro', 'inst', 'img', 'img']

for r in range(4):
    ax_b.text(hm_x0 - 0.15, hm_y0 + r * cell + cell / 2,
              row_labels[r], fontsize=5.5, ha='right', va='center', color=TXT2)
    for c in range(4):
        v = attn[r, c]
        fc = '#F5F5F5' if v < 0.01 else plt.cm.Blues(v * 0.7 + 0.15)
        rect = plt.Rectangle(
            (hm_x0 + c * cell, hm_y0 + r * cell), cell, cell,
            facecolor=fc, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
        ax_b.add_patch(rect)

# Highlight readout→instruction cell
rect_h = plt.Rectangle(
    (hm_x0 + 2 * cell, hm_y0), cell, cell,
    facecolor='none', edgecolor=TEAL, linewidth=1.5, zorder=5)
ax_b.add_patch(rect_h)

# Arrow from heatmap
hm_right = hm_x0 + 4 * cell + 0.3
hm_mid_y = hm_y0 + 2 * cell
farrow(ax_b, hm_right, hm_mid_y, hm_right + 1.2, hm_mid_y)

tx = hm_right + 1.5
ax_b.text(tx, hm_mid_y + 0.4, 'readout → instruction', fontsize=7,
          ha='left', va='center', color=TEAL, fontweight='bold')
ax_b.text(tx, hm_mid_y - 0.4, 'readout → image', fontsize=7,
          ha='left', va='center', color=AMBER, fontweight='bold')

# Bracket for "attention ratio"
br_x = tx + 4.5
ax_b.plot([br_x, br_x], [hm_mid_y - 0.6, hm_mid_y + 0.6],
          color=TXT2, lw=0.5, zorder=3)
ax_b.plot([br_x - 0.15, br_x], [hm_mid_y - 0.6, hm_mid_y - 0.6],
          color=TXT2, lw=0.5, zorder=3)
ax_b.plot([br_x - 0.15, br_x], [hm_mid_y + 0.6, hm_mid_y + 0.6],
          color=TXT2, lw=0.5, zorder=3)

         lw=0.7, ls='-', pad=0.12, zorder=3, fontstyle='normal'):

        facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw,
        linestyle=ls, zorder=zorder)

        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=tc, fontweight=fontweight,
                fontstyle=fontstyle, zorder=zorder + 1)

def farrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=LN, lw=0.8, ms=10,
           style='->', conn=None):

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

# ─── Color palette ────────────────────────────────────────────
TEAL    = '#0072B2'
AMBER   = '#E69F00'
CORAL   = '#D55E00'
GREEN   = '#009E73'

TEAL_L  = '#E8F4FD'
AMBER_L = '#FFF8E1'
CORAL_L = '#FDE8E4'
GREEN_L = '#E8F8F0'

TXT     = '#333333'
TXT2    = '#777777'
TXT3    = '#AAAAAA'
LN      = '#888888'

# ─── Figure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.5), facecolor='white')
ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.04, 0.26, 0.88])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.30, 0.04, 0.38, 0.88])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.72, 0.04, 0.27, 0.88])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b, ax_c]:
    ax.axis('off')

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
def rbox(ax, cx, cy, w, h, label='', fc='white', ec='#CCC',
         fontsize=9, fontweight='normal', tc=TXT,
         lw=0.7, ls='-', pad=0.12, zorder=3, fontstyle='normal'):
    b = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
        boxstyle=f'round,pad={pad}',
        facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw,
        linestyle=ls, zorder=zorder)
    ax.add_patch(b)
    if label:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=tc, fontweight=fontweight,
                fontstyle=fontstyle, zorder=zorder + 1)

def farrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=LN, lw=0.8, ms=10,
           style='->', conn=None):
    props = dict(arrowstyle=style, color=color, lw=lw, mutation_scale=ms)
    if conn:
        props['connectionstyle'] = conn
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1), arrowprops=props)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL (a): VLA sequence structure
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_a.set_xlim(-2, 11)
ax_a.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)

ax_a.text(-1.5, 10.2, '(a)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='top')
ax_a.text(0.0, 10.0, 'VLA sequence structure', fontsize=9, va='top', color=TXT2)

CX = 4.5
BW = 7.0
BH = 1.3

# Image tokens
y_img = 8.2
rbox(ax_a, CX, y_img, BW, BH, fc=TEAL_L, ec=TEAL, ls='--', lw=0.6)
ax_a.text(CX - 1.5, y_img + 0.1, 'Image tokens', fontsize=9,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT, zorder=4)
for k in range(4):
    px = CX + 0.6 + k * 0.85
    ax_a.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (px - 0.25, y_img - 0.25), 0.5, 0.5,
        boxstyle='round,pad=0.04', facecolor=TEAL, alpha=0.22,
        edgecolor=TEAL, linewidth=0.3, zorder=4))

# Instruction tokens
y_ins = 5.6
rbox(ax_a, CX, y_ins, BW, BH, fc=AMBER_L, ec=AMBER, ls='--', lw=0.6)
ax_a.text(CX, y_ins + 0.28, 'Instruction tokens', fontsize=9,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT, zorder=4)
ax_a.text(CX, y_ins - 0.28, 'pick up the red block', fontsize=7.5,
          ha='center', va='center', color=TXT2, fontstyle='italic', zorder=4)

# Readout (R) + Action head
y_bot = 3.0
rbox(ax_a, CX - 1.8, y_bot, 2.2, 1.0, 'R', GREEN, GREEN,
     fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', tc='white', lw=0.5)
rbox(ax_a, CX + 1.8, y_bot, 2.2, 1.0, 'Act', CORAL, CORAL,
     fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', tc='white', lw=0.5)

# Vertical arrows
farrow(ax_a, CX, y_img - BH/2, CX, y_ins + BH/2)
farrow(ax_a, CX - 1.0, y_ins - BH/2, CX - 1.8, y_bot + 0.5)
farrow(ax_a, CX + 1.0, y_ins - BH/2, CX + 1.8, y_bot + 0.5)

# Red X between image and instruction (clearly outside boxes)
mid_y = (y_img + y_ins) / 2
xx = 9.2
d = 0.3
ax_a.plot([xx - d, xx + d], [mid_y - d, mid_y + d],
          color='#CC0000', lw=2.5, zorder=5)
ax_a.plot([xx - d, xx + d], [mid_y + d, mid_y - d],
          color='#CC0000', lw=2.5, zorder=5)
ax_a.text(xx, mid_y - 0.55, 'cannot attend\nto instruction', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='center', va='top', color='#CC0000')

# Arc arrow: image → readout (attends to all context)
farrow(ax_a, CX - BW/2 - 0.2, y_img,
       CX - 1.8 - 1.1, y_bot + 0.2,
       color=TEAL, lw=1.2, conn='arc3,rad=0.45')
ax_a.text(-0.8, (y_img + y_bot) / 2 - 0.3, 'attends to\nall context',
          fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center', color=TEAL,
          fontstyle='italic')

# Position labels
ax_a.text(CX, y_img - BH/2 - 0.12, 'image_mean', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='center', va='top', color=TXT3, fontstyle='italic')
ax_a.text(CX - 1.8, y_bot - 0.6, 'readout', fontsize=6.5,
          ha='center', va='top', color=TXT3, fontstyle='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL (b): Three analysis methods
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_b.set_xlim(-0.5, 14)
ax_b.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)

ax_b.text(-0.3, 10.2, '(b)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', va='top')
ax_b.text(1.2, 10.0, 'Three analysis methods', fontsize=9, va='top', color=TXT2)

# ── Method 1: Layer-wise action probes ────────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 9.0, 'Layer-wise action probes', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

m1y = 8.0
for i, lbl in enumerate(['L1', 'L2', 'L3']):
    rbox(ax_b, 0.7 + i * 1.1, m1y, 0.8, 0.6, lbl, TEAL_L, TEAL, fontsize=7.5)

farrow(ax_b, 3.2, m1y, 4.0, m1y)
rbox(ax_b, 4.8, m1y, 1.5, 0.6, 'Probe', '#F5F5F5', LN, fontsize=8)
farrow(ax_b, 5.55, m1y, 6.3, m1y)
rbox(ax_b, 7.5, m1y, 2.2, 0.6, '7-DoF action', CORAL_L, CORAL, fontsize=7.5)

# R² badge
rbox(ax_b, 9.3, m1y + 0.55, 0.65, 0.55, 'R²', '#FFEEEE', CORAL,
     fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', tc=CORAL, pad=0.12)

# ── Method 2: Counterfactual perturbation ─────────────────────
ax_b.text(0.2, 6.2, 'Counterfactual perturbation', fontsize=8.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=TXT)

m2y = 5.3
capsules = [
    ('✓ correct instr.', GREEN_L, GREEN, 2.5),
    ('∅ empty',          '#F0F0F0', '#999999', 1.5),
    ('✗ wrong',          '#FFEEEE', '#CC0000', 1.5),
    ('◇ shuffle',        AMBER_L,   AMBER,    1.7),
